test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 25 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A can do a piece of work in 12 days and B can do it in 30 days. They work on alternate days; starting with A. In how many days will the work be completed?
solution:
**Given:

A can do a piece of work in 12 days 

B can do it in 30 days.

Calculations:**

A can complete work in 12 days

B complete work in 30 days

LCM of (12, 30) is 60 then total work is 60 parts
